name: swallowtail
_about: A swallowtail (Papilio machaon), 8 cm across the wings: yellow with black veins and bands, the forewing's base dusted black; a row of blue lunules across the hindwing's black border, a red eye at its inner corner and a black tail; the body black above with a yellow stripe along each side. Six walking legs. Basking, wings spread. Written whole by tools/creaturegen/rework/winged/butterflies.py on insectlib.py + wlib.py (each wing one sheet, its upperside's painting laid on it as thin sheets in layers -- the 2D butterflies' own paintings, assets/butterflies/; the wings beat in the variant "flying").
